global_issues.title: 10-Year Yield Hits Highest Since 2007 as Markets Price Fed Hike
global_issues.note: Confirmed by CNBC, Bloomberg, CNN, Investing.com: 10Y yield reached ~5.04%, highest since July 2007. Fed decision is due today, Sept 16 2026 at 2pm ET (91-92% market-implied odds of a 25bp hike) — this is the actual resolution event and is imminent, not yet a factual error but worth flagging as the next catalyst.

global_issues.title: Saudi East-West Pipeline Shut, Oil Spikes on Iran Conflict Escalation
global_issues.note: Confirmed: pipeline shut Sept 11 after drone attacks (Iran-linked/Iraq-launched), Brent ~$107-108/bbl, WTI ~$103-105, four-month highs, Hormuz traffic also disrupted. 'Multimonth highs' framing matches reporting.

grok_report.summary: The two headline global issues (10Y yield >5%, Saudi pipeline/oil spike) are both accurately and currently reported. However, the briefing omits a major, watchlist-relevant story: the AI-safety-driven chipmaker selloff (NVDA, MU, and peers) from Sept 14-15, and doesn't flag that today's FOMC decision is the actual resolving catalyst for the yield narrative it leads with.
